# Native shape-autofit reference controls

These original files are generated by `tools/shape_autofit_fixture.py`, using
python-docx (MIT), lxml (BSD) and the repository's original XML shape helpers.
They contain no corpus artwork or separately distributed font files.

Six files cover `a:noAutofit`, `a:spAutoFit` and an omitted autofit element in
compatibility modes 14 and 15. Each file has twelve pages: standalone shapes
and groups with a 2x coordinate transform, 18pt and 120pt initial heights,
and top/center/bottom vertical anchors. All have a 120pt physical width,
3pt insets, Arial 12pt text that wraps to five lines, and body text before/after.

Reference exports show:

- `spAutoFit` grows the 18pt box and shrinks the 120pt box to **75pt**.
- Text retains its font size; the shape resizes around the five lines.
- Following body text moves by the fitted-height change. Merely enlarging the
  preview bitmap or unclipping text is insufficient.
- All three anchors yield the same fitted result, as no spare vertical space
  remains after fitting.
- Omission and explicit `noAutofit` have identical page rasters in these cases.
- The same behavior occurs in both tested compatibility modes and in groups.

`tools/shape_autofit_reference.py` extracts the colored shape bounds and body
baselines from native PDFs, verifies the statements above, and pins source,
PDF and 144-DPI RGB hashes in `reference.json`. These measurements are
independent of the application. Browser regressions compare all 72 pages against
this oracle, including the following body baselines, within 0.2pt.

Specification: ECMA-376 Part 1 §21.1.2.1.4 `spAutoFit`, §21.1.2.1.1 `bodyPr`,
and the `CT_TextShapeAutofit` declaration in §A.4.1. The published [MS-OE376]
[implementation note](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/openspecs/office_standards/ms-oe376/19d31037-28bf-4693-85be-3a37bfe82d51)
clarifies the older text-scaling wording: implementations resize the containing shape.
The [SDK's reproduced specification example](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/dotnet/api/documentformat.openxml.drawing.shapeautofit?view=openxml-3.0.1)
also describes resizing when text is added. The controls establish the behavior
on opening an existing WPS document, including body reflow.

The implementation computes fitted geometry after font measurement and shares
it across pagination, painting and hit testing without changing source runs or
drawing XML. Browser checks cover no-edit preservation, body edits, exact undo
and reopening. Additional mixed/nested groups, ellipse, outline, paragraph
spacing and empty-text controls live in `../shape-autofit-edges/`.
Page-dependent fields and relative page sizing combined with autofit remain
guarded. Source 114 is still partial because of decorated text-box runs.
